summary: The pump had no mains power; they siphoned fuel from the underground tank into cans. The red jerry can on the seat was roughly six liters of fuel when they finished.
The pump kept clicking and spitting; power at the station is out and the pump is dead. Siphoning was used.
Dan's pickup started on the second try. Truck stereo is dead; battery is weak but will start the engine once or twice.

Handheld radio received an intermittent transmission: '— get to the highway. Move. Highway clear—' before breaking to static. The handheld had intermittent bursts of signal; the truck stereo was dead.
The map is marked 'OLD BRIDGE — WEIGHT LIMIT'; county detour adds ~25 minutes and crosses the rail yard. Otto advises avoiding the bridge if possible.
Group decision and plan: load truck, aim to reach the highway before dark, debate over route and tactics (use radio as bait vs. fast low travel).
They load the truck and depart the gas station, agreeing to 'get to the highway before dark'. The pickup starts on the second try and drives off.
